name: Scala
description: Scala combines object-oriented and functional programming on the JVM. It powers high-performance data pipelines (Apache Spark), distributed systems (Akka), and type-safe web applications. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Creative Scala
items.description: A fantastic free beginner book by Dave Gurnell and Noel Welsh teaching functional programming through computer graphics and visual exercises.

items.title: Scala 3 Book (Official)
items.description: The official Scala 3 book covering everything from the Tour of Scala to advanced functional patterns in the new syntax.

items.title: Official Scala Documentation Hub
items.description: Central entry point for all Scala guides — Scala 3 references, migration guides, and best practices.

items.title: Tour of Scala
items.description: Official interactive tour covering OOP, functional programming, pattern matching, and type system features.

items.title: Scala 3 Reference
items.description: Technical specification for Scala 3 context parameters, match types, enums, and metaprogramming.

items.title: Scala Exercises
items.description: Interactive platform to practice standard library features, functional programming, and libraries like Cats directly in the browser.

items.title: LearnScala.org
items.description: A completely free browser-based interactive tutorial covering variables, types, functions, and collections.

items.title: Rock the JVM — Scala at Light Speed
items.description: A fast-track free video course covering modern Scala 3 for experienced programmers by Daniel Ciocîrlan.

items.title: DevInsideYou YouTube Channel
items.description: Hundreds of free Scala screencasts, live coding sessions, and architecture tutorials covering Scala 3.

items.title: Exercism — Scala Track
items.description: Mentor-backed code reviews with structured exercises using standard build tools.

items.title: Codewars — Scala Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in Scala across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: Visual Scala Reference
items.description: A phenomenal visual guide mapping out common methods of the Scala Collections API.

items.title: Scala 3 Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise reference covering Scala 3 syntax, types, collections, and functional patterns.

items.title: Scala Times
items.description: A free weekly newsletter curated by SoftwareMill covering Scala news, libraries, and conferences.

items.title: This Week in Scala
items.description: A regular digest tracking new tutorials, GitHub releases, and community proposals.

items.title: Scala Users Discourse
items.description: Official forum where language designers, maintainers, and learners discuss features and troubleshooting.

items.title: Scala Discord
items.description: Active real-time chat for getting help with compiler errors, sbt configs, and idiomatic Scala.

items.title: Reddit r/scala
items.description: Community hub for discussions, library announcements, and Scala news.

lessons.title: Getting Started with Scala 3
lessons.description: Set up the Scala toolchain and write your first programs in the REPL and with sbt.

lessons.title: Values, Variables and the Type System
lessons.description: Understand vals, vars, primitive types, and how Scala infers and converts types.

lessons.title: Control Flow: if, match and Loops
lessons.description: Write expressive branching with if-expressions and pattern-matching match expressions.

lessons.title: Defining Functions
lessons.description: Write functions with parameters, default values and named arguments.

lessons.title: Higher-Order Functions and Lambdas
lessons.description: Transform collections with map, filter, fold and other higher-order functions.

lessons.title: Collections: List, Vector, Map and Set
lessons.description: Choose the right immutable collection and use its API effectively.

lessons.title: Case Classes and Pattern Matching
lessons.description: Model data with case classes and destructure it with pattern matching.

lessons.title: Classes, Traits and Inheritance
lessons.description: Build object-oriented abstractions with classes, traits and extension.

lessons.title: Immutability and Functional Style
lessons.description: Write pure, referentially transparent code that avoids shared mutable state.

lessons.title: Option and Either for Safe Handling
lessons.description: Replace null and exceptions with Option and Either for total functions.

lessons.title: For Comprehensions and Monadic Composition
lessons.description: Sequence and transform monadic values with for comprehensions.

lessons.title: Generics and the Type System
lessons.description: Write reusable code with type parameters, bounds and variance.

lessons.title: Type Classes and Givens
lessons.description: Implement ad-hoc polymorphism with type classes and given instances.

lessons.title: Concurrency with Futures and Promises
lessons.description: Run work on thread pools and combine asynchronous results with Futures.

lessons.title: Files and I/O
lessons.description: Read and write files, parse lines, and stream large inputs lazily.

lessons.title: Testing with munit and ScalaTest
lessons.description: Write unit tests, property tests and test suites for Scala code.

lessons.title: Error Handling with Try and Either
lessons.description: Model failures explicitly and recover with Try, Either and validated data.

lessons.title: Builds and Dependencies with sbt
lessons.description: Configure builds, manage dependencies and run tasks with sbt.

lessons.title: Tail Recursion and Performance
lessons.description: Write stack-safe recursion and reason about allocation and performance.

lessons.title: Contextual Abstractions in Depth
lessons.description: Master using clauses, given instances and contextual lookup for flexible APIs.

lessons.title: Putting It All Together
lessons.description: Build a complete idiomatic Scala program combining FP, OOP and safe IO.
